title: 微软四分之一员工：收到买断选项，6万人里谁先走？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We also have some breaking news crossing the Bloomberg terminal. Microsoft is offering buyouts to 60,000 employees here with us for the story.
segments.zh: 彭博终端也有突发新闻。微软向6万名员工提供买断方案，我们来看详细报道。

segments.en: Bloomberg's Brody Ford. Brody, what do we need to know?
segments.zh: 彭博的Brody Ford。Brody，有什么关键信息？

segments.en: 60,000's a lot of people, right? I mean, we've seen a lot of tech companies try to shed their workforce.
segments.zh: 6万人可不少，对吧？我们看到很多科技公司都在尝试精简人员。

segments.en: The meta is Google's Microsoft or the world are betting that they can do more with less people with AI and their cash flow is strained from all this AI spending.
segments.zh: 现在的趋势是，谷歌、微软等公司都押注能用更少的人借助AI做更多事，而他们的现金流因AI支出而紧张。

segments.en: And so this is the latest strategy Microsoft is taking to try to get some cost off as books.
segments.zh: 所以这是微软为削减成本而采取的最新策略。

segments.en: Buyouts, they do that typically like what's the history of how Microsoft handles this kind of reduction?
segments.zh: 买断方案，他们通常这样做吗？微软过去如何处理这类减员？

segments.en: Very limited. They did a retirement buyout earlier this year, and that was the first large scale we've seen.
segments.zh: 非常有限。今年早些时候他们做过一次退休买断，那是我们首次看到的大规模行动。

segments.en: To me, this is a bit friendly aversion of the Elon extremely hardcore Twitter buyout.
segments.zh: 在我看来，这比埃隆在推特那种极其强硬的买断要友好一些。

segments.en: A lot of people will remember when he bought Twitter, he said, okay, if you're sticking around, it's going to get a little tougher from here, and if not, you can take a buyout.
segments.zh: 很多人记得他收购推特时说，如果留下来，情况会变得更艰难，否则可以拿买断方案离开。

segments.en: That's the energy I'm getting from Microsoft, right? They're saying we need to be focused on this mission, and you know, if you're thinking about not being here, maybe you shouldn't be.
segments.zh: 我从微软感受到的就是这种氛围：他们说要专注于使命，如果你在考虑不在这里，也许你就不该留下。

segments.en: One thing I would point out is that as of June 30th, Microsoft has 223,000 employees.
segments.zh: 我想指出一点，截至6月30日，微软有22.3万名员工。

segments.en: So that buyout number, like to me, that seems big. We're most brody Ford with the news that you need.
segments.zh: 所以那个收购数字，对我来说似乎很大。我是Brody Ford，为您带来您需要的新闻。
